review.summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR issues found in the final WP03 shell diff. The unpublished, no-version, no-effective-date notice is conservative and correct for the stated D-5 deferral. The role=status div replacement for the aside is valid, and policy paragraphs are untouched and asserted in tests. The tests are meaningful, and the dl/dt/dd structure is valid HTML. Remaining items are low-severity: dropped review-boundary and not-legal-advice wording on policy pages, redundant triple "unpublished" messaging with duplicated notice markup, and static-content role=status plus the unverified color-contrast result. Whole WP03 remains INCOMPLETE as declared; this review covers only the supplied technical shell, and production CSS and the real Next server were not exercised.

findings.issue: PolicyDocument no longer shows the explicit review-required marker (finance/support/legal), the responsible owner, or the 'not legal advice / not formal policy / release sign-off' statement. The only per-page caveat is now '以下內容為草稿，尚未生效。'
findings.evidence: The removed PolicyDraftNotice usage rendered {status} and '核准責任：{owner}。這個頁面不構成法律意見、正式政策或 release sign-off。' The replaced test asserted 'explicit human review boundary'; the new test asserts the opposite for status.
findings.impact: A reader of a single policy page sees 'draft, not effective' but loses the signal that legal/finance review is pending and that the page is not legal advice. The footer partly compensates but does not mention legal advice or review.
findings.recommended_fix: Confirm with the D-5 owner that dropping the legal-advice and review-pending wording is intentional. If not, add a static sentence to the new notice, e.g. '本草稿尚待法務、財務與客服審閱，不構成法律意見。', without rendering the raw status/owner fields.
findings.required_test: Assert the chosen static review/legal-advice sentence appears for every policyDrafts entry, and that a mutated status/owner still does not leak into the output.

findings.issue: The unpublished notice duplicates the PolicyDraftNotice markup and classes inline. The same 'not published / not effective' fact is stated three times on one page (title '（草稿）', notice, dl) and once in the footer. PolicyDraftNotice is now unused by PolicyDocument, while support and merchant pages still render raw status/owner, so the pages show different publication signals.
findings.evidence: Inline <div role="status" className="rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-sm text-amber-950"> duplicates PolicyDraftNotice's wrapper classes. The dl hard-codes '尚未發布' and '尚未生效'.
findings.impact: Style drift risk and extra edits when D-5 supplies a real version and date. This is cosmetic only and has no correctness impact today.
findings.recommended_fix: Optionally extract a shared notice wrapper, or leave as is with the existing D-5 comment. Do not expand scope in this WP.
findings.required_test: None required. Existing tests cover the rendered strings.

findings.issue: role="status" is a live region, but the content is static at SSR, so it has little announcement value. Color contrast was not verified against production CSS, because axe ran on static SSR output without the compiled stylesheet.
findings.evidence: Task summary: 6 static SSR semantic axe checks pass on Chromium/Firefox; production CSS and the actual Next server are NOT_RUN. Palette classes are amber-950 on amber-50, slate-700, and slate-600 on white.
findings.impact: The semantic result is valid, but a contrast claim cannot be made from this evidence. The palette is expected to pass, but this is unverified.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep NOT_RUN labelled in the evidence. Optionally use a plain div or role="note" for static notices. Run axe color-contrast against the production build before any WP03 completion claim.
findings.required_test: Production-build axe run (color-contrast enabled) on /policies/[slug], /policies, and the support and merchant pages in Chromium and Firefox.

findings.issue:
Two assertions are brittle: (1) the paragraph check compares against renderToStaticMarkup(

{paragraph}

), which breaks if the component ever adds a className to the paragraph; (2) not.toContain(draft.status) depends on the status string not appearing in summary or section text.
findings.impact: Possible false failures after unrelated styling changes. No false pass today.
findings.recommended_fix: Optionally assert on the escaped paragraph text, or use a testing-library getByText. Keep the metadata-leak test as is.
findings.required_test: None beyond keeping the current suite green.
